messages:
elaine-cs: Heads up: Sunfield Clinics requested a temporary APAC regional boost and allowlist for a Japan pilot next Fri 22:00-02:00 UTC. They're on Hosted PAYG. Renewal health depends on pilot reception. can ops help?
tom-sre: what's the requested QPS and CIDRs? Also want org id. we should define circuit-break thresholds.
elaine-cs: org id org-sf-92. requested peak qps 1,200 (baseline ~150). CIDRs: 13.113.196.0/24, 13.113.197.0/24. timeframe 2026-04-09T22:00:00Z to 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z. target p95 < 350ms.
mohit-platform: we can pin to ap-northeast-1 edge and add those CIDRs to the proxy allowlist. Hosted will still multi-region fallback unless we add a transient route pin. recommend temp_policy max_qps 1400 and circuit 1800. will need to reserve burst capacity.
tom-sre: plan: create temp rate-policy + allowlist, soft cap 1.4k qps, breaker 1.8k. enable KV cache prewarm for common prompts. snippet to apply (informal): {org:org-sf-92, start:2026-04-09T22:00Z, end:2026-04-10T02:00Z, max_qps:1400, cb:1800, allowlist:["13.113.196.0/24","13.113.197.0/24"]}
deploy-bot: ticket #CS-9001 created for temp policy and allowlist. assigned to tom-sre. auto-revoke scheduled.
ops-oncall: confirmed capacity in ap-northeast-1 for that window; reserving burst pool. will enable token-level tracing and create an ephemeral dashboard. please ensure customer uses ephemeral keys and avoids long-lived tokens.
mohit-platform: added transient route pin to ap-northeast-1, policy queued for deployment. also enabling prefix cache warm for org-sf-92.
elaine-cs: i'll send the prewarm checklist and ask them to run test prompts at 21:30 UTC. i'll also schedule the renewal follow-up and ask AE to join.
tom-sre: policy deployed -> policy_id=tmp-sf-92-20260409. allowlist applied. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-sf-92/session-20260409
elaine-cs: sweet. i'll collect post-demo feedback and any error traces. thanks all :pray:
